title: CIPHERTEXT BASED QUORUM CRYPTOSYSTEM
one_sentence_summary: A quorum cryptosystem that encrypts key fragments as ciphertexts using post-quantum KEMs, allowing a subset of holders to reconstruct a shared secret key via polynomial interpolation.
primary_inventive_claim: The invention provides a method for generating a quorum key by splitting a secret into fragments, encrypting each fragment as a ciphertext using a Key Encapsulation Mechanism, and distributing these ciphertexts to fragment holders.
